summary: Analog Devices Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $3.0 billion 364-day revolving credit facility with Bank of America as administrative agent and several co-documentation agents and joint lead arrangers. The facility expires July 1, 2027, with optional one-year extensions and a conversion right to a term loan at maturity. Borrowings are prepayable without penalty. This is a routine credit facility arrangement, not a special situation event.
